title: SDD apply — tui
content:
All **15 TUI acceptance scenarios** are implemented on the existing starter. Commit: `ce4e8ff`.

### What landed
- Dashboard with project/env/vars/footer; secrets masked (`●●●●●●●●`)
- Add / edit (secret echo masked; non-secret cleartext) / delete with `y` confirm
- Multi-env compare (`development` · `staging` · `production`) with presence glyphs and non-secret divergent values
- Validation findings in the status area (`v`)
- Providers, agent activity, approval modal (masked old, proposed new, Allow once / Allow for project / Deny)
- Allow-for-project grants scoped to **actor + env** until revoked

### Review summary
| Axis | Findings |
|------|----------|
| **Standards** | File sizes OK after split; Bubble Tea still mutates model in place (idiomatic); proposed new values intentionally cleartext for approval |
| **Spec** | All 15 covered by acceptance tests; minor extras (protected-env block, `[A]` bridge) retained from starter |

`go test ./...` passes.
